record.question: Who invented photocopier?
record.explanation: Xerox's original technology history credits Chester Carlson with inventing xerography in 1938. He is the only listed inventor of the photocopying process; distinguish the process from later commercial machine development. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://xerox.com/downloads/dl/usa/en/innovation/innovation_storyofxerography.pdf Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
